# Srivatsa Vaidikam (ಶ್ರೀವತ್ಸ ವೈದಿಕಂ)

> Authentic Vedic Purohit Services, Pitru Karyas, Homams, Samskaras, and Jyotishya by Pandit Keerthi Bharadwaj across Srirangapatna, Mysore, Mandya, and Karnataka.

## Organization & Pandit Details
- **Organization Name**: Srivatsa Vaidikam
- **Chief Purohit**: Pandit Keerthi Bharadwaj (ಪಂಡಿತ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜ್)
- **Primary Locations**: Srirangapatna (Paschima Vahini), Mysuru (Mysore), Mandya, Karnataka, India
- **Experience**: 15+ Years in Vedic Rituals, Shastras & Ceremonies
- **Ceremonies Performed**: 5,000+ Sacred Ceremonies
- **Languages Spoken & Chanted**: Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), Sanskrit (ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ), Hindi (हिन्दी), English
- **Official Website**: https://srivatsavaidikam.com/
- **Contact Email**: contact@srivatsavaidikam.com
- **Availability**: All 7 days by prior appointment (Home visits & Sacred Kshetra riverbank rituals)

---

## Core Service Locations & Kshetras

### 1. Srirangapatna (ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣ - Paschima Vahini & Kaveri Sangama)
Srirangapatna is renowned worldwide for sacred ancestral liberation (Pitru Mukti) on the banks of the sacred Kaveri River (Paschima Vahini / Triveni Sangama).
- **Specialized Rituals**:
  - Asthi Visarjana & Pinda Pradhanam
  - Narayana Bali & Moksha Narayana Pooja
  - Tripindi Shraddha & Tila Homa
  - Ashlesha Bali & Sarpa Samskara (Kaveri riverbanks)
  - Mahalaya Pitru Paksha Shraddha & Amavasya Tarpanam

### 2. Mysore / Mysuru (ಮೈಸೂರು)
Serving all Mysuru layouts (Gokulam, Vijayanagar, Kuvempunagar, JP Nagar, Saraswathipuram, Jayalakshmipuram, etc.) and Nanjangud Kapila Sangama.
- **Specialized Rituals**:
  - Griha Pravesha & Vastu Shanti Havan
  - Vivaha Samskara (Vedic Wedding ceremonies)
  - Maha Ganapati, Sudarshana & Maha Mrityunjaya Homam
  - Sri Chamundeshwari / Durga Saptashati Chandi Homa
  - Grand Floral Deity Alankara & Festival Utsavas

### 3. Mandya (ಮಂಡ್ಯ)
Serving families and communities across Mandya, Maddur, Pandavapura, Malavalli, Nagamangala, and K.R. Pet.
- **Specialized Rituals**:
  - Satyanarayana Swamy Pooja & Katha
  - Upanayanam (Sacred Thread / Munji)
  - Namakarana & Annaprashana
  - Vastu Shanti & Navagraha Homam

### 4. Bangalore & Statewide Karnataka
- Travels across Bangalore and all Karnataka districts for large Maha Yajnas, residential apartments, corporate office poojas, and temple consecrations.

---

## Complete List of Sacred Ceremonies & Poojas

### A. Pitru Karyas & Ancestral Rites (Srirangapatna Paschima Vahini Special)
1. **Asthi Visarjana & Pinda Pradhanam**: Sacred immersion of mortal remains at Kaveri Paschima Vahini Sangama with traditional pinda pradhanam and tila tarpanam.
2. **Narayana Bali & Moksha Pooja**: Invoking Lord Maha Vishnu to liberate souls from unnatural deaths, pitru doshas, and karmic bondage.
3. **Tripindi Shraddha & Tila Homa**: Three consecrated pindas (satva, rajas, tamas) with sesame fire oblations to eliminate severe Pitru Dosha.
4. **Pitru Tarpanam & Annual Shraddha**: Sacred ancestral rites, Amavasya Tarpanam, and Mahalaya Paksha ceremonies performed with complete devotion.

### B. Sacred Fire Ceremonies (Homam & Havans)
5. **Maha Ganapati Homam**: Invoking Lord Vighnaharta with Ashtadravya to remove obstacles and assure victory.
6. **Sudarshana & Narasimha Homam**: Powerful Vaishnava fire ritual with Sudarshana Yantra mandala to destroy evil eye (Drishti), fear, and negative energies.
7. **Maha Mrityunjaya Homam**: Life-giving Shiva mantra havan for speedy recovery from chronic illness and protection from untimely death.
8. **Maha Chandi Homa**: 700 verses of Durga Saptashati for legal victory, supreme protection, and overcoming immense obstacles.
9. **Navagraha Homam & Shanti**: Pacifying the nine planetary deities with Samidhas and mantras during adverse Dasha periods.
10. **Ayushya Homam**: Consecrated fire ceremony for birthdays and elders praying for vitality, health, and longevity.
11. **Sri Dhanvantari Homam**: Invoking the divine physician of Gods with medicinal herbs for relief from severe health problems.
12. **Swayamvara Parvathi Homam**: For overcoming delays in finding a life partner and early marriage blessings.
13. **Santana Gopala Homam**: Dedicated to Bala Krishna for progeny, conception, and smooth childbirth.
14. **Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Homam**: For debt clearance (Rina Vimochana), business obstacles, and spiritual shield.

### C. Samskaras & Life Milestones
15. **Griha Pravesha & Vastu Havan**: Complete housewarming ritual including Go-Pooja, Dwara Pooja, Ganapati Homa, and Vastu Shanti.
16. **Vivaha Samskara**: Authentic Vedic wedding ceremonies including Kanyadaana, Mangalya Dharana, Saptapadi, and Laja Homa.
17. **Upanayanam**: Sacred thread initiation rite with Gayatri Mantra Upadesha and Brahmopadesha.
18. **Namakarana & Annaprashana**: Traditional naming based on Janma Nakshatra and first solid food feeding.
19. **Shashtiabdha Poorthi (60th Birthday)**: Ugraratha Shanti and renewal of marital vows with Ayushya Homa.

### D. Festivals & Devotional Vratas
20. **Satyanarayan Pooja & Katha**: 5-chapter Katha recitation and Kalasha Sthapana for family peace and prosperity.
21. **Sri Mahalakshmi & Kubera Pooja**: Worship of Goddess Lakshmi and Kubera for wealth, financial stability, and business growth.
22. **Shiva Rudrabhisheka / Laghu Rudra**: Panchamrita Abhishekam to Lord Shiva chanting Sri Rudram and Chamakam.
23. **Ganapati Pooja & Sankashti Vrata**: Worship of Lord Ganesha with 21 Modakas, Durva grass, and Atharvashirsha chanting.
24. **Durga Pooja & Navratri Anushthana**: Devi Mahatmya parayana and kumkumarchana for divine courage and protection.
25. **Saraswati Pooja & Vidyarambham**: Worship of Goddess Saraswati and Aksharabhyasa ritual for initiating education.

### E. Dosha Shanti & Planetary Remedies
26. **Sarpa Shanti & Naga Pratishtha**: Intricate Naga mandala rangoli pooja, Ashlesha Bali, and Sarpa Samskara on Kaveri riverbanks.
27. **Ashlesha Bali Pooja**: Specialized serpent deity worship on Ashlesha Nakshatra for Sarpa and Kuja Dosha.
28. **Vastu Shanti & Dosha Nivarana**: Appeasing Vastu Purusha to correct architectural and directional flaws.
29. **Kala Sarpa Dosha Parihara**: Special Vedic ritual pacifying Rahu and Ketu to remove setbacks and delays.

### F. Additional Vedic Specialties
30. **Vedic Jyotishya & Muhurtha**: Janma Kundali analysis, horoscope matching for marriage, and Subha Muhurtha calculation.
31. **Divya Alankara**: Master floral artistry for deity prabhavalis, grand kalasha adornment, and temple utsavas.
32. **Vedika Seva & Parayana**: Veda Samhita Parayana, Bhagavata Saptaha, and Valmiki Ramayana chanting.

- Auspicious Muhurtha selection provided
- Complete Pooja Samagri list and copper Homa Kunda arrangement
